chooseResponse.q: What's the best way to study for finals?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Hey, have you thought about what you're doing for finals? 
Advisor: Yeah, I’m planning to start studying next week. What about you? 
Student: I haven’t really figured it out yet. I might just wait until the last minute. 
Advisor: I wouldn’t recommend that. Starting early helps a lot.

questions.explain: 顧問建議早點開始準備考試。

questions.q: How does the student feel about studying?
questions.explain: 學生對於學習感到不確定。

announcement.transcript: Attention all students: The library will be open extended hours during finals week, from 8 AM to midnight. Please take advantage of this time to study and prepare for your exams. We wish you the best of luck!

questions.q: When will the library be open?
questions.explain: 圖書館在期末考週的開放時間是早上八點到午夜。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the announcement?
options: To announce a new library policy
questions.explain: 公告是為了通知學生圖書館的開放時間。

talk.transcript: Today, I want to discuss the concept of photosynthesis. Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants and some other organisms convert light energy into chemical energy. This typically occurs in the chloroplasts of plant cells, where sunlight is absorbed by chlorophyll. During this process, plants take in carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil, and through a series of reactions, they produce glucose and oxygen. This is not only vital for the plants themselves but also essential for life on Earth, as it provides oxygen for us to breathe and food for many organisms.

questions.explain: 光合作用是將光能轉換為化學能的過程。
光合作用發生在植物細胞的葉綠體中。

questions.q: What do plants produce during photosynthesis?
questions.explain: 植物在光合作用中產生葡萄糖和氧氣。
光合作用對於生命至關重要，因為它提供食物和氧氣。
